details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:859-873 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The round-cap exemption for heads with a judge merge verdict was removed, so the condition `jq -e '(.head_gate_state // "") as $s | $s != "" and $s != "success"'` now caps any head whose gate is not success. This includes judge `lease_wait` and `checks_not_ready` verdict heads, which always have a pending gate (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 2759-2790, with gate success posted only at line 2798).
  WHY: When the lease is granted or the checks settle, `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` prints nothing, so the row reaches the cap and `review_sweep_round_cap_escalate` labels an approved PR `ai:needs-human` with nothing dispatched. This is the #9515/#9839 failure that G4 forbids, and no test covers a verdict head whose verdict changed. Both reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2771-2775 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `[ "${RB_MERGE_STATUS}" = "checks_not_ready" ] && RB_MERGE_WAIT_TOKEN="checks_not_ready"` (the same pattern recurs in the terminal branch around line 2896) excludes only the `failed` outcome. A verdict marker is therefore posted for `query_failed`, `unresolved_head_sha`, `unavailable` and unknown outcomes (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 1372-1383), even though the check state was never read.
  WHY: `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` treats the marker as still waiting, so the sweep returns `rb_judge_merge_deferred` and stall recovery skips the judge indefinitely. This breaks the fail-open requirement ("when the verdict or the waiting state cannot be read, dispatch as today"), and `test_judge_sets_the_wait_token_only_on_benign_deferrals` does not cover `query_failed`. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2645-2693 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `rb_judge_record_verdict_wait` records `base=` from a `repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}` read taken after the merge deferral. That is not the base the judge checked for freshness (`PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_SHA`, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 1533-1536, checked at review_rb_judge.sh lines 2759 and 2776-2777).
  WHY: If the base moves under the PR's files between the freshness check and that read (for example during `_pr_wait_for_required_checks`), the marker records the new base as already judged. `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` then sees no base move and skips `_pr_base_freshness`, so the overlap change that G2 says must re-dispatch the judge is silently absorbed. Reviewers rated this MAJOR, with confidence ranging from 3 to 4.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4050-4052 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` treats a `failure|error` `vw_checks` rollup (from `statusCheckRollup.state`, scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh line 130) as `PR_RB_VERDICT_CHANGE="checks"`, but the verdict description does not record the rollup state at verdict time.
  WHY: A head whose rollup was already failing when the verdict was posted counts as "changed" on every tick. Examples are an optional red check, or a failing required status context of the #9939 shape at the `wait=blocked` guard (review_rb_judge.sh:2808-2817). The sweep and stall recovery then re-dispatch every cycle, which recreates the G1/G2 loop. The round cap does not bound heads that have head-gate success. All three reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4050-4052 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` treats only failure or error as a check-state change. It does not compare the current check result with the result at verdict time.
  WHY: If a required check goes from pending to success while another missing check keeps mergeStateStatus blocked, the helper reports the verdict as unchanged and the sweep skips a review that should run.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4088-4091 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_refresh_base` re-posts `ai-review/rb-judge-verdict` after each clean, non-overlapping base move. Stall recovery calls it through `_stall_rb_judge_verdict_unchanged`, and each re-post resets the `createdAt` that `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert` (scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh lines 331-335) uses as the alert age for heads without head-gate success.
  WHY: Repeated base moves (main merged about every hour) keep restarting the timer, so lease-deadlocked heads of the #9573/#9637 class never reach `VERDICT_MERGE_WAIT_ALERT_HOURS=6` and the single G3 alert never fires. Severities disagreed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated MAJOR and openai_gpt-6-luna rated NIT, so the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4852-4903
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `VERDICT_WAIT_DISPATCH_SKIP_ENABLED` is not wired into the `Review-blocked judge` step env block, so `review_rb_judge.sh` keeps its `true` default and continues posting `ai-review/rb-judge-verdict` even when the repository variable is `false`.
  WHY: The switch does not fully restore today's behaviour. The source output is truncated mid-sentence and does not state a severity or confidence.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:783-787 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `reason=merge_lease_wait` skip only fires `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert` behind `review_sweep_verdict_wait_enabled`, but the README documents the alert as applying to heads skipped as `reason=merge_lease_wait` regardless of the switch.
  WHY: With the switch set to `false`, merge-lease-wait heads are still skipped but never alert. Operators cannot see this coupling from the documented variable table.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G4, "The round cap must not label a PR ai:needs-human when its current head already has a verdict; it stays in force for heads that are still not approved."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the round-cap condition at line 866 (`'(.head_gate_state // "") as $s | $s != "" and $s != "success"'`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The only verdict-head exemption (`verdict_wait_switch` and the `.rb_judge_verdict` test in the cap's jq filter) was removed and not replaced. `lease_wait` and `checks_not_ready` verdict heads always have a pending gate (review_rb_judge.sh lines 2757-2798, with tokens set at 2766/2775/2786 before gate success at 2798/2826). tests/test_review_sweep_round_cap.py lines 553-565 (`test_unevaluated_judge_merge_verdict_head_stays_capped`) now asserts capping in both switch states, and no test covers a verdict head after its lease is granted or its verdict changes.
- requirement: "A switch (default on) that restores today's behaviour when set to false." The README also says "`false` restores every dispatch, and the judge stops posting the status."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, the Review-blocked judge step env block (lines ~4852-4875 / ~4862-4866, next to `MAX_REVIEW_BLOCKED_RETRIES` and `ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE`), reached through review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `VERDICT_WAIT_DISPATCH_SKIP_ENABLED` is wired only into review_autofix_sweep.yml:270 and orchestrate_poll.yml:1710/1898. scripts/review_rb_judge.sh defaults the unset variable to true (lines 2665-2668), and the poller step env does not propagate across a `gh workflow run` dispatch. The judge therefore keeps posting `ai-review/rb-judge-verdict` when the variable is `false`. Severities disagreed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated NIT (dispatch is still restored) and the other two rated MAJOR.
- requirement: G3, "raises one alert through the existing stuck-merge alert path"
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh, `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert`
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The function makes its own `tg_send_msg` call, readiness checks and `ai-review/merge-wait-alert` marker instead of reusing the merge-train stall-alert helper. Behaviour is equivalent, so this is a delivery-shape mismatch (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:865-873 (plus scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 2759-2790, 2798) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The round-cap exemption for judge merge-verdict heads was removed. `lease_wait` and `checks_not_ready` heads keep a pending gate and get capped once the lease is granted or the checks settle.
  WHY: An approved PR is labelled `ai:needs-human` at the exact moment it could merge (#9515/#9839), which violates G4. Only the missing-library case is tested.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2771-2775 (and ~2896; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 1372-1383) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `checks_not_ready` token is set for `query_failed` and unknown outcomes, not only for `failed`.
  WHY: The sweep returns `rb_judge_merge_deferred` forever and the PR stays stuck until someone pushes, which breaks fail-open. Suggested fix: set the token only when `PR_CHECKS_WAIT_OUTCOME` is `timeout`.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2675-2685 (`rb_judge_record_verdict_wait`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `base=` comes from a PR read taken after the deferral, not from `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_SHA` (pr_checks_lib.sh 1533-1536).
  WHY: A base move during the checks wait is recorded as already judged, so the G2 overlap re-dispatch is silently absorbed.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4050-4052 (`_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting`; scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh line 130) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `statusCheckRollup` includes optional, cancelled and timed-out checks, and the verdict does not record the rollup at post time.
  WHY: A head with an optional check that was already failing re-dispatches every tick, which defeats G1/G2.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_refresh_base` (called from scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_stall_rb_judge_verdict_unchanged`; age read in scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Each base refresh re-posts the verdict and resets the `createdAt` used as the alert age.
  WHY: Hourly merges reset lease-deadlocked heads (#9573/#9637) to zero, so the 6h G3 alert never fires.
